svg.text: COMMON GND · J1− + J3− + U1 + U2 + U3–U6 + sensor / LED returns
J2− isolated; fan stays on when SW1 opens.
● Joined wires ○ Terminal Crossings without dots do not connect. V5 labels join Uno 5V; VM5 is separate.
R6–R9 + LED1–LED4 are optional. Motor modules use onboard drivers. Route load returns directly to their supplies.
* Confirm L298N external 5 V logic support before removing 5V-EN. ENA and ENB jumpers removed. No load current through Uno.
Thermal stack: contact plate → interface → TEC1 → interface → heatsink → fan. TH1 on plate; TH2 on heatsink base.
Reference wiring • Peltier / fuse / stop ratings TBD • Temperature shutdown not implemented • Motor PWM 255 test confirmed by user
